run_id.description: Unique trial identifier (UUIDv4 or sequential integer)

trial_idx.description: Sequential trial index within a scenario sweep (0 to N_trials-1)

scenario_id.description: Project-defined test scenario ID (1-5 for canonical scenarios, 0 for Monte Carlo sweeps)

bitrate_regime.description: Unavailable in local datagram execution; no physical CAN measurement.

nominal_baud.description: Unavailable in local datagram execution; no physical CAN measurement.

data_baud.description: Unavailable in local datagram execution; no physical CAN measurement.

fault_model.description: Injected fault model classification per ISO 26262-5 Annex D

injected_dropped_frame_indices.description: Semicolon-delimited list of targeted frame indices (e.g. '14;15;16'), or 'NONE' for clean bus

burst_length.description: Number of consecutive dropped frames in the burst (0 for clean, 1 for single, 3/8 for bursts)

channel_loss_rate_p.description: Applied channel loss probability for Monte Carlo sweeps (0.00 for deterministic scenarios)

payload_corruption_injected.description: Whether a bit-flip was injected into the payload to test Ascon-AEAD128 tag verification failure (separate from frame drop)

recovery_success.description: High-level session completion flag (True = payload reassembled and cryptographically verified)

recovery_rounds.description: Number of retransmission cycles executed (0 = clean first-pass, 1-3 for retry rounds)

retransmit_policy.description: Recovery mechanism type used by the protocol under test

nack_frames_issued_count.description: Total NACK or Flow Control frames transmitted across all retry rounds

nack_bitmaps_issued_hex.description: Semicolon-delimited hexadecimal 64-bit NACK bitmaps transmitted per round (e.g. '0x0000000000041000;0x0000000000040000'). Only applicable to SIXTY_FOUR_BLOCK protocol.

round_1_requested_frames.description: Missing frames requested in Round 1 NACK

round_1_recovered_frames.description: Retransmitted frames successfully received in Round 1

initial_frames_sent.description: Data frames transmitted in initial burst (41 for 60/4, 39 for ISO-TP, 12 for Castiglione native)

retransmitted_frames_count.description: Total data frames resent across all retry rounds

control_frames_count.description: Total control frames on wire (NACK + Flow Control + Restart NACK)

total_frames_on_wire.description: Unavailable in local datagram execution; no physical CAN measurement.

total_wire_bytes.description: Unavailable in local datagram execution; no physical CAN measurement.

goodput_efficiency_pct.description: Unavailable in local datagram execution; no physical CAN measurement.

end_to_end_latency_us.description: Measured host time from immediately before first data send through authentication or failure.

nominal_clean_time_us.description: Theoretical or empirical baseline duration under clean bus (0% loss)

recovery_overhead_latency_us.description: Signed difference between observed latency and referenced clean run; includes host variability.

nack_turnaround_time_us.description: Measured host time from immediately before NACK send to first successfully received retry.
nack_turnaround_time_us.nullable_reason: No retry frame successfully received, including clean bus, NACK omission and complete retry loss.

retry_exhaustion_flag.description: True if maximum retries (K_retry = 3) were exhausted without complete assembly

termination_status_code.description: Project-defined diagnostic outcome; not an ISO-standard literal code.

iso26262_failure_classification.description: Project classification only; no ISO 26262 compliance claim.

ftti_budget_us.description: User-selected experimental deadline, not a HARA-derived budget.

ftti_violation_flag.description: True if end_to_end_latency exceeds ftti_budget (safety goal violation)

safety_state_achieved.description: Software activation decision only; no physical actuator is controlled.
